data.name: Minerrr
data.detailed_description:
Minerrr is an idle/incremental mining game where every click brings you closer to bigger upgrades, stronger workers, and deeper zones.

Break ores by clicking, earn money, scrap, and XP, then spend your resources on upgrades that improve your mining power, worker efficiency, and overall progression. Hire workers to automate mining, unlock new ore types, and push further into new zones.

When progress slows down, make a sacrifice to reset your normal upgrades and gain permanent skill tree bonuses, making every new run faster and stronger than the last.

Mine, upgrade, sacrifice, repeat and grow your mining operation one run at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable performance on most modern integrated GPUs. Heavy spawn rates may lower framerate on older CPUs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 60+ FPS performance under typical gameplay conditions. Performance scales with CPU speed during high object counts.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (quad-core, 2015 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (Apple Silicon or AMD; integrated graphics supported)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable on recent Macs
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 (Ventura) or later
  • Processor: Apple M3 or M1 Pro / Max / Ultra, or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable on recent Macs
